 The Southern California News Group's photos from the top high school football games Friday, Nov. 6.

 Newbury Park Panthers Dylan Miramontes (14) stretches out to make a catch during the first half of a Division 4 CIF-SS playoff prep football game against the Downey Vikings at Downey High School in Downey on Friday, November 6, 2026. (Photo by Libby Cline Birmingham, Contributing Photographer)
 By Staff report PUBLISHED: November 6, 2026 at 8:58 PM PST | UPDATED: November 6, 2026 at 10:04 PM PST Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... The high school football action Friday night in Southern California included some of the season’s best games and player performances.
 Check out the Southern California News Group’s large collection of photos from the biggest games Friday. Also, make sure you take a look at all of our coverage in the high school sports section.
 Bishop Amat’s Kanan Khansarinia (9) signals for the ball during warm-ups ahead of the first round of the CIF-SS Division 2 football playoffs against Oxnard Pacifica at Bishop Amat High School in La Puente on Friday, Nov. 6, 2026. (Photo by Trevor Stamp, Contributing Photographer)
 Palos Verdes receiver Jalen Flowers pulls in TD catch. Serra at Palos Verdes CIFSS Division 2 1st round football playoff game Friday November 6, 2026 (Photo by Robert Casillas, Contributing Photographer)
 Valley View’s Dominic DuBois is swarmed by St. Francis defenders during a first-round CIF-SS Division 6 playoff game at St. Francis High School in La Cañada on Nov. 6, 2026.(Photo by Andy Holzman, Contributing Photographer)
 Quartz Hill’s Kemir Smith (2) is swarmed by the Hart High School defense during their CIF Southern Section Division 4 playoff game in Quartz Hill, Calif., on Friday, Nov. 6, 2026. (Photo by Rob Curtis, Contributing Photographer)
 Valley View’s Dominic DuBois is guarded by St. Francis’ Anthony Matthews III as he tries to make a catch during the first round of the CIF-SS Division 6 playoffs at St. Francis High School in La Cañada on Nov. 6, 2026.(Photo by Andy Holzman, Contributing Photographer)
 Bishop Amat’s Ayden Bias (18) carries the ball into the end zone to score a touchdown against Oxnard Pacifica during the first round of the CIF-SS Division 2 football playoffs at Bishop Amat High School in La Puente on Friday, Nov. 6, 2026. (Photo by Trevor Stamp, Contributing Photographer)
 Newbury Park Panthers Darrien Johnson (4) holds up a number one sign after scoring a touchdown during the first half of a Division 4 CIF-SS playoff prep football game against the Downey Vikings at Downey High School in Downey on Friday, November 6, 2026. (Photo by Libby Cline Birmingham, Contributing Photographer)
 Palos Verdes QB Ryan Rakowski struggles to stay inbounds. Serra at Palos Verdes CIFSS Division 2 1st round football playoff game Friday November 6, 2026 (Photo by Robert Casillas, Contributing Photographer)
 Huntington Beach quarterback Brady Edmunds (9) is under pressure against Inglewood in a CIF-SS Division 2 first-round playoff game at Coleman Stadium on Friday November 6, 2026. (Photo by Axel Koester, Contributing Photographer)
 Bishop Amat head coach, Kory Minor, center, rallies his team before they take on Oxnard Pacifica in the first round of the CIF-SS Division 2 football playoffs at Bishop Amat High School in La Puente on Friday, Nov. 6, 2026. (Photo by Trevor Stamp, Contributing Photographer)
 Downey Vikings running back Max Acosta (26) scores a touchdown during the first half of a Division 4 CIF-SS playoff prep football game against the Newbury Park Panthers at Downey High School in Downey on Friday, November 6, 2026. (Photo by Libby Cline Birmingham, Contributing Photographer)
